summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.finished_time field, finished property based on finished_time, _reset clears it, TimeElapsedColumn class, capture in Progress.update and Progress.advance under lock, clear in Progress.reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with lazy imports and TYPE_CHECKING Table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased/Added entry); tests/test_progress.py (import, test_time_elapsed_column unit test, TimeElapsedColumn in test_columns, hand-traced expected output); tests/test_palette.py (new). Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Expected test_columns output was derived by hand-tracing the mock clock, so it is unverified until the test suite runs. One python3 heredoc was used to add the changelog entry (no repo code run). Possible concern: update refreshes before capturing, so the frame that reaches the total may still show live elapsed time, which follows the spec ordering.
